description: F29 component manifest. Read-only input to tools/wd_bridge_doctor.py. Paths are never stored here: every component names a key in the separate local paths config (wd.bridge-local-paths.v1). The doctor never installs; install entries are instructions for a human operator only.

components.description: Git for Windows; trusted absolute git.exe used by bridge plumbing.

instructions: Install Git for Windows from https://git-scm.com/download/win using the version recorded in the release notes.
Set git_executable in the local paths config to the absolute path of git.exe (for example the cmd\git.exe of that installation).

components.description: CPython 3.13 interpreter pinned by the bridge code package.

instructions: Install CPython 3.13 for the current user from https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/ using the version recorded in the release notes.
Set bridge_python_executable in the local paths config to the absolute path of that python.exe; the bundle manifest pins its SHA-256.

components.description: Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell.exe) used by the pinned bridge scripts.

instructions: Windows PowerShell 5.1 ships with Windows; if it is missing, repair the Windows installation.
Set windows_powershell_executable in the local paths config to the absolute path of powershell.exe.
Install PowerShell 7 from https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases using the version recorded in the release notes.
Set pwsh_executable in the local paths config to the absolute path of pwsh.exe.

components.description: Bridge runtime root holding shared/events.jsonl (data, not source).

instructions: Create or restore the bridge runtime root with the documented first-run initialization; never point it at a source checkout.
Set bridge_runtime_root in the local paths config to that absolute directory.

components.description: Codex CLI used by the Codex lanes.

instructions: Install the Codex CLI with its supported installer at the version recorded in the release notes, then authenticate interactively as the operator.
Set codex_executable in the local paths config to the absolute path of the codex executable.

components.description: Claude Code CLI used by the Claude lanes.

instructions: Install Claude Code with its supported installer at the version recorded in the release notes, then authenticate interactively as the operator.
Set claude_executable in the local paths config to the absolute path of the claude executable.

components.description: Grok CLI used only by the on-demand advisory helper.

instructions: Install the Grok CLI with its supported installer at the version recorded in the release notes, then authenticate interactively as the operator.
Set grok_executable in the local paths config to the absolute path of grok.exe.

features.description: PowerShell 7 parity runs of the bridge scripts.
On-demand Grok advisory consultation for the Lead.
